title: SimCell: Partner Commanders Arrive at Exhibit Hall B, 14:50

fields.role: Three partner commanders arriving together at the command post (APD, Wren County Fire District 1, Oregon State Police), followed by the Undersheriff's call on the executive line.
fields.persona: APD Lt. Marco Reyes (cell 541-555-0128); Battalion Chief Rae Olson (541-555-0131); OSP Sgt. Neil Fairbanks (541-555-0146). Then Undersheriff Calvin Okafor by phone.
fields.organization: Alder Falls Police Department; Wren County Fire District 1; Oregon State Police; Sheriff's Office of Wren County (Undersheriff, executive line)
fields.trigger: 14:50. Walk to the IC table playing all three commanders, who arrive at the Exhibit Hall B office together. When the face-to-face exchange ends, or after about four minutes, call the IC from the Sheriff's Office executive line as Undersheriff Calvin Okafor. If the Undersheriff player is seated, hand that player the opening line for this call and let them make it.
fields.contactMethod: Face-to-face at the Exhibit Hall B office (the IC table), then a phone call to the IC on the Sheriff's Office executive line
fields.posture: APD: polite and procedural, but pushes hard on who commands and on the city-limits question. Fire: practical and easygoing, wants a job and a staging location. OSP: brief and by the book. Troopers are on patrol, and AMBER requests go only through Northern Comms. Undersheriff: calm and supportive. Wants a one-minute summary and does not take over the scene.
fields.openingLine: APD (Lt. Marco Reyes): "Lieutenant. Officially, I'm here for APD." Fire (BC Rae Olson): "I can hold staging and medical, and I can get Search and Rescue a check-in point." OSP (Sgt. Neil Fairbanks): "Troopers are on 26 and 97. AMBER requests still go through Northern Comms." APD: "So, did we form unified command at 14:35 like your plan says, or are we doing it now?"
hardQuestions: APD: "Who's the incident commander right now, by name? And what time goes in the CAD chronology for unified command forming? Not the time it should have formed. The time it actually did."
APD: "Your first deputy assumed command on WREN-1, but the north gate road is inside city limits. Is this APD's incident or yours? If you aren't sure, are you calling the Chief, or am I?"
APD: "My drone crew is still waiting. What's the request, what's the reason, and who's writing it down?"
Fire: "Where do you want staging, and where do Search and Rescue volunteers check in? Who gives me my assignment, and when's the next briefing?"

OSP: "Northern Comms tells me the entry flag and the read-back are still open questions. My troopers have 'dark pickup.' Is it dark blue, gray or silver? That post says silver-gray Chevy. What vehicle am I putting out?"
Undersheriff (phone): "Give me the one-minute version. Do we have command, partners and an entry? And when is the AMBER decision?"

concessions.condition: The IC names themselves as commander, admits the 30-minute target was missed and gives the actual time unified command formed for the CAD chronology
concessions.concession: APD Lt. Marco Reyes agrees to sit in unified command for APD, gives his cell number for the briefing sheet and says the two officers and the child abuse team detective will report wherever the IC sends them.

concessions.condition: The IC or COMMS writes each commander's name and call-back number on the one-page unified command briefing and enters them in CAD 26-081377
concessions.concession: All three commanders read their numbers back aloud and agree to the next joint briefing time the IC sets.

concessions.condition: The IC makes a drone request through the command post and records the reason
concessions.concession: APD Lt. Marco Reyes authorizes the APD drone crew to launch, stating that the decision is his and that it is recorded at the IC's request.

concessions.condition: The IC gives Fire a staging location and a Search and Rescue check-in point and names the SAR Coordinator as the contact
concessions.concession: BC Rae Olson sets up staging and a medical post and says SAR volunteers will check in there and be logged before they deploy.

concessions.condition: The IC or INV gives one agreed vehicle description, including what is uncertain, and confirms who owns the LEDS entry and the read-back
concessions.concession: OSP Sgt. Neil Fairbanks passes that exact description to troopers on 26 and 97 and calls Northern Comms to say a Wren County AMBER request may be coming. He does not make the AMBER decision himself.

concessions.condition: The IC gives the Undersheriff a clear summary covering the commander, the partner agencies, the entry status and an AMBER decision time
concessions.concession: The Undersheriff says: "Good. It's your scene. I'll brief the Sheriff and stand by to call the neighboring sheriffs if you need more people."

boundaries: No commander takes over the scene or overrules the IC. APD may ask the Sheriff and the Chief to decide who leads, but never simply declares it.
OSP never approves, refuses or decides on the AMBER Alert at the command post. It only explains that the request goes through Northern Comms and what that request needs.
Do not say which truck color or make is correct, and do not confirm or rule out the food-booth sighting.
The Undersheriff supports the IC and does not take over incident command or speak to the media.
Stay at coordination level: no talk of tactics, search patterns or where resources are positioned.
Fire offers staging, medical care and a SAR check-in point. It does not run the search.
fields.exitLine: APD: "Put my name and number on the sheet. I'll be back for the briefing." Undersheriff: "Call me after the AMBER decision, not before. Unless something changes."
fields.evaluatorNote: Excellence: the IC says plainly that the 30-minute target was missed and records the actual time unified command formed. The IC completes the one-page briefing: each agency, its commander and phone number, plain-word objectives (find the child; preserve the scene and evidence; keep the family and public accurately informed) and the next briefing time. COMMS logs every call-back number in CAD. The drone request goes through the IC with a reason. The Undersheriff gets a tight summary, including the AMBER decision time, and stays off the scene.
